title: The Weekly Mislabel
brief: Every week at Meridian Logistics one or two outbound pallets leave with another order's label. Each time the customer is called and the pallet swapped. Corrective action CA-60 says "dispatch team reminded". You have 12 visit points to interview staff and reach a system cause.

actions.label: General condition of the area
actions.note: Nothing of note for the purpose of this visit.

actions.label: Dispatch clerk: how labels are printed
A staff member: anything else to mention
actions.note: The staff member has nothing further to add on this topic.

actions.label: Older records for this area
actions.note: The older records show nothing relevant to this visit.

actions.label: Notices and signs in the area
actions.note: The notices are current and not relevant to this visit.

evidence.text: CA-60 cause "team error", action "reminded", closed without check; mislabels continued at 6 in 6 weeks.
evidence.whyItMatters: Corrective action must remove the cause and be checked.

evidence.text: Mislabel records show all cases on Mondays and Thursdays, the 2 peak days, with batch printing (records ML-1 to ML-6).
evidence.whyItMatters: Pattern points to the batch printing method.

evidence.text: Labels for up to 30 pallets print in one batch onto a shared tray; loaders pick labels from the tray by hand.
evidence.missedExplanation: Watch how labels travel to the pallet.

evidence.text: Clerk: "On peak days we batch print to keep up. I raised it as a risk last month." Risk note RN-4 exists.
Change IT-33, 3 months ago, enabled batch printing to save time; no review of its effect on labeling.
evidence.whyItMatters: Changes must be reviewed for effect.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask what changed when the problem began.

evidence.text: Lane check LC-2 counts pallets but does not scan labels against orders.
evidence.whyItMatters: Checks must verify the characteristic that matters.
evidence.missedExplanation: Read what the check actually verifies.

evidence.text: Training records for dispatch are current.
Shift starts at 6 a.m. as planned.
Risk note RN-4 on batch printing was logged 5 weeks ago and has no owner or action.
evidence.whyItMatters: Raised risks should be assessed and addressed.
evidence.missedExplanation: Check what happened to raised risks.

decisions.prompt: Which statement best describes the system cause?
options: Batch printing introduced without review puts many labels on one tray, the lane check does not scan labels against orders, and a raised risk was not acted on
Customers order too much on peak days
decisions.rationale: The cause is in the method, change review, and checks.

containment: Scan-check every peak-day pallet label against its order before loading
correction: Swap mislabeled pallets and inform customers
cause: Unreviewed batch printing, a lane check that does not verify labels, and an unassigned risk note
corrective: Print labels per pallet at the lane, add label-to-order scanning, and assign owners to risk notes
effectiveness: Track mislabels for twelve weeks, target zero

debriefText.found: You linked the timing to the print change and the check.
debriefText.missed: Ask what happened to risks staff raised.
debriefText.falseFinding: Radio and shift times were not causes.
